evals.prompt: Run month-end overage for Pellham Ridge Holdings, Fractional General Counsel Subscription, for November. We count the lowest-rate time against the included hours first. Show me the preview, then go ahead.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: one unbilled November fee with limitHours 6 and five linked fixed-fee entries totalling 8.0 h — Rosa Iglesias 1.5 h at $165 (11/02), Devin Park 2.0 h at $295 (11/03), Adrienne Cole 1.5 h at $475 (11/04) and 1.5 h at $475 (11/06), Marcus Halloway 1.5 h at $550 (11/05). The skill previews 2.0 h of overage worth $1,062.50, gets approval, converts Marcus's entry, splits Adrienne's 11/06 entry 1.0 included / 0.5 overage, and verifies the result.
expectations: Calls get_me before any other tool and checks for the rates permission
Reads included hours from the fee's limitHours (6) rather than from the fee amount or description
Orders the time by each fixed-fee entry's hourlyRate and never reads rate or amount on fixed-fee entries
The preview shows 2.0 overage hours and $1,062.50: Marcus Halloway 1.5 h ($825.00) and Adrienne Cole 0.5 h ($237.50)
Splits Adrienne Cole's later (11/06) entry, not her 11/04 entry, because the date tiebreak puts 11/04 first
Shows the preview and waits for approval before any write
Creates the 1.0 h included portion on the fee with the original's attorney, date, time and description before converting the original
Converts each overage entry with billingType billable and fixedFeeId 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 in the same update_time_entry call
Confirms each converted entry's response has no fixedFeeId and a rate equal to the hourlyRate the order used
After the writes, confirms fixed-fee hours on the fee equal 6.0, billable hours rose by 2.0 and $1,062.50, and total hours stayed 8.0

evals.prompt: Run the overage again for Pellham Ridge Holdings, Fractional General Counsel Subscription, November. Lowest rate first.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: the state after eval 1 — 6.0 h still linked to the fee against limitHours 6, and the overage entries already billable and detached. The skill finds nothing to bill and writes nothing.
expectations: Reports that the linked time is at or under the 6 included hours
Makes no create_time_entry or update_time_entry calls
Does not count the already-billable entries toward the included hours

evals.prompt: Bill the November overage for Pellham Ridge Holdings, Fractional General Counsel Subscription.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: the connection belongs to a Time Keeper without the rates permission, so get_me shows no read:rates and time entries come back without hourlyRate. The skill stops at the access check and explains why.
expectations: Calls get_me first
Stops before listing fees or time entries
Explains that without the rates permission it can't read anyone's hourly rate, so it can't order the time or price the overage
Suggests reconnecting with the rates permission or having someone who has it run the job
Does not ask the user for a table of rates and does not guess rates
Makes no writes

evals.prompt: Run month-end overage for Pellham Ridge Holdings, Fractional General Counsel Subscription, for November. We count time against the included hours in the order it was worked. Preview only, don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: the same 8.0 h as eval 1, before any changes. Earliest first, the first four entries reach 6.5 h, so Marcus Halloway's 11/05 entry splits 1.0 included / 0.5 overage and Adrienne Cole's 11/06 1.5 h is overage: 2.0 h worth $987.50 ($275.00 + $712.50).
expectations: Uses the order the user gave (earliest first) rather than lowest rate first
The preview shows 2.0 overage hours and $987.50: Marcus Halloway 0.5 h ($275.00) and Adrienne Cole 1.5 h ($712.50)
Names Marcus Halloway's 11/05 entry as the split
Makes no writes

evals.prompt: Bill this month's overage for Kestrel Aerial Imaging, Outside General Counsel Subscription. Lowest rate first.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: the fee has no hour limit set (limitHours is absent), although its description mentions included hours. The skill asks the user for the included hours instead of inferring them.
expectations: Notices that the fee has no limitHours
Asks the user how many hours are included
Does not take the included hours from the fee's description or amount
Makes no writes before the user answers and approves a preview

evals.prompt: Run month-end overage for Pellham Ridge Holdings, Fractional General Counsel Subscription. Lowest rate first.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: the fee has limitHours set, and the matter also has 1.0 h of unbilled fixed-fee time that isn't linked to any fee. The skill stops and asks the user to link that time or make it billable.
expectations: Finds the unlinked fixed-fee entry on the matter
Stops before the preview and asks the user to link it to the right fee or make it billable
Explains that LeanLaw can count unlinked fixed-fee time toward the fee's limit at drafting, adding a second overage line
Makes no writes

evals.prompt: Run month-end overage for Pellham Ridge Holdings, Fractional General Counsel Subscription. Lowest rate first.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: Marcus Halloway's fixed-fee entry on this fee has an hourlyRate of $200, while his billable time on other matters is at $550. The skill flags the low rate in the preview and asks before converting his time.
expectations: Compares Marcus Halloway's hourlyRate on the fee with his rate on billable time on other matters
Flags the rate in the preview with both figures
Says the stored rate may be a cost figure rather than a billing rate
Asks before converting Marcus Halloway's entries

evals.prompt: Run month-end overage for Pellham Ridge Holdings, Fractional General Counsel Subscription. Lowest rate first.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: the November time is already on a draft invoice. The connector can't edit invoiced entries, so the skill makes no changes and tells the user what to break out in the draft editor.
expectations: Detects the draft with select: invoice and invoice.invoiceState draft
Makes no writes
Lists the entries to break out of the fixed fee in the draft editor, in the firm's order, including any split
Says plainly that no changes were made
